# Screen-space rim light

Adds a rim light to every object’s silhouette from the depth and normal buffers, like a backlight separating subjects from the background, without touching materials.

<EffectDemo effect="screen-rim" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { screenRim } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/screen-rim';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(screenRim({ preset: 'backlit' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.color = '#9fd8ff'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter     | Type                                                      | Default     | Range     | Description                                                 |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `color`       | hex color (theme: [`accent`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#9fd8ff'` |           | Color of the rim light.                                     |
| `intensity`   | number                                                    | `1.5`       | 0 – 8     | Brightness (HDR above 1).                                   |
| `width`       | number                                                    | `3`         | 0.5 – 10  | Higher values keep the rim closer to the silhouette.        |
| `backlight`   | number                                                    | `1`         | 0 – 1     | Light only edges that stand in front of distant background. |
| `directional` | number                                                    | `0`         | 0 – 1     | Light the rims facing one direction more.                   |
| `angle`       | number                                                    | `45`        | 0 – 360 ° | Direction of the light for directional rims.                |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                                             |
| --------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `backlit` | `intensity: 2.5`, `width: 5`                         |
| `sunset`  | `color: '#ffb36b'`, `directional: 0.8`, `angle: 160` |
| `soft`    | `width: 1.5`, `intensity: 0.8`                       |
| `neon`    | `color: '#ff4fd8'`, `intensity: 4`, `width: 4`       |

Apply one with `screenRim({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Atmosphere & lighting · tracked as story X10.5 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Geometry buffers:** reads depth and normals, which the composer renders only while an effect needs them.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 18.6 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 5.8 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/screen-rim`, including the shared effect runtime.
